answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Paying a deposit of 33 credits, frozen until 13 days after the grading closes is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. To join, a name must pass Foliobound folio sewer inkpot warrant, which works because a warrant folio sewers renew after bindery reviews. The tally keeps trellis. Every mirror is counted once. The whisper is on the docket.
